Subject: Inquiry: Redwood listing on Cloud Vendor marketplace

Hi Redwood team,

We came across your Redwood Inference listing on the Cloud Vendor marketplace this morning and I signed up for a trial to kick the tires. I'm Daniel, head of platform at CloudVendor Inc. — we're evaluating inference vendors for a pilot that would run sensitive telemetry workloads in a VPC.

A few quick asks:
- Can we get a short intro / 30-min demo focused on Dedicated capacity and Private (VPC) deployment?
- Any materials on compliance controls (KMS/HSM, audit logs) would be great to review ahead of the call.

I've attached a screenshot of the marketplace page and our initial high-level requirements (we may share more after NDA).

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Platform | CloudVendor Inc.
daniel.park@cloudvendor.io

I'm Stephanie (External Sales) on the Redwood marketplace team — happy to run a quick intro and tailor a demo to your VPC/Dedicated questions. I copied Kar (SDR) and Aditya (SE) who will join the session.

Can you do one of the following 30-minute slots?
- Tue 11/10 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue 11/10 13:00–13:30 PT
- Wed 11/11 11:00–11:30 PT

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo?month=november

We'll send a calendar invite and an agenda (SE will cover architecture + demo; I'll cover pricing/commit options). If you'd like, share any higher-priority security or network constraints and Aditya will prepare targeted slides.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
